content.text: This is a baseline configuration reference; it does not establish your present experience or circumstances.
The baseline driver field is not a current priority ranking.

Astronomical coordinates are calculated outputs. Gate and Line sources, Driver and Personality/Design roles, Semantic Tags, composition rules and Runtime Owner rules are governed interpretation authorities; they are not evidence of biological causation or guaranteed outcomes. Personal C1–C5 or Current Reality values require admitted case-specific evidence. Unresolved fields remain unknown, with the complete unknown record retained in the technical evidence appendix.

V4.1 now has owner-accepted Driver, Personality/Design, Semantic Tag, compositional and Runtime Owner rules. A personal Question / Capability orientation is published only when this case has an admitted Gate + Line + Driver + Layer composition with explicit tag evidence. The calculated baseline remains available; without that case-specific binding, orientation remains unknown.

V4.1 now has owner-accepted Driver, Personality/Design, Semantic Tag, compositional and Runtime Owner rules. A personal Question / Capability orientation is published only when this case has an admitted Gate + Line + Driver + Layer composition with explicit tag evidence. The calculated baseline remains available; without that case-specific binding, orientation remains unknown.

Figures 4A–4B define the Carrier architecture and the R7 owner rules now govern how semantic composition may become K2A / Carrier evidence. Personal hierarchy, capacity, constraint, integrity, connectivity or recovery-baseline values are published only when the case supplies admitted composition and evidence; otherwise the architecture is known while the personal result remains unknown.

Figure 4C defines the C1 Carrier Runtime fields, and R7 now provides governed semantic and owner rules for resolving them. Personal intake, environment, perception, cognition, biology, regulation, connectivity, cost or Carrier Runtime Style is shown only when an admitted case-specific composition resolves to C1 with sufficient evidence; otherwise those values remain unknown.

Figure 5A defines the C2 Experience engine. R7 may route an admitted composition to C2 when the semantic object is explicitly about experience, attention, valuation, selection or perspective. Without sufficient case-specific evidence for that ownership, experience filter, stability, perspective, motivation, emotional weighting and meaning orientation remain unknown.

Figure 5B defines the C3 Expression engine. R7 may route an admitted composition to C3 only when translation, compression, externalization, medium or expression threshold is explicitly supported. Without that case-specific evidence, expression drive, translation, compression, architecture, threshold, medium and expression style remain unknown.

Figure 5C defines the C4 Agency engine. R7 may route an admitted composition to C4 when the semantic object concerns direction, evaluation, exclusion, commitment, resource allocation, choice or execution readiness. Without sufficient case-specific evidence, direction, decision strategy, choice, conflict, responsibility, commitment and execution readiness remain unknown.

Figure 5D defines the C5 Identity engine. R7 may route an admitted composition to C5 only when identity stabilization, self-model or role continuity, identity boundary, drift or identity reconfiguration is explicitly supported. Personality layer alone never assigns C5, and no fixed identity type is inferred; unsupported personal identity values remain unknown.
The continuity architecture describes states for comparison, not a predicted life sequence.

content.text: No Current Reality observations are bound to this review case. V4.1 supports observation and comparison only; semantic architecture or Runtime Owner assignment does not by itself establish a current driver priority, bottleneck, overload, drift, recovery, runtime state or action conclusion. Those remain unknown without separately admitted current evidence.
You may record observations and compare them with the baseline; birth configuration alone supplies no current action conclusion.
